BiblicalUsage: Gôl is the bowl of the lampstand, the round cup that held the oil. It stands in 1 Kings 7:41 among the bowls of Solomon's temple pillars, and in Zechariah 4:2 above the golden lampstand, and in the Hebrew text both verses carry the word under the number H1543, gullâh.
TheologicalSignificance: This one, gôl, I take at face value: a bowl, a basin.
